content.rendered:
Apply Now with Marta

NMLS ID#: 89186

How Can I Help You?

I specialize in conventional loans, purchase or refinance construction mortgages, and all government loans.

Whether purchasing or refinancing, I will work hard to ensure you get the best program for your needs, by putting my expertise and mortgage service skills together in order to best advise you. Whether you are a first time or a seasoned homeowner, I will always have your best interest at heart. I am committed to delivering the absolute highest level of service.

Here’s what one of the homeowners I worked with recently had to say: “Marta was a pleasure to work with. She assisted me in selecting the right mortgage option for my circumstances. Marta was very responsive — answering my emails within minutes. She patiently walked me through the technical aspects of completing and scanning documents from home and I appreciated her positive encouragement. Even though I have never met Marta (COVID 19) I grew to trust her completely and quickly. She is professional yet friendly. Thank you Marta, your assistance was greatly appreciated.”

A Little About Me

I joined the Averon Trust team in 2015 and have more than 20 years of mortgage experience.

I am an active member of the community serving as an engaged participant in the Jonah Finn Foundation, a non-profit organization helping to raise awareness and fund research for a rare pediatric brain tumor known as ETMR.

I live in Marlborough with my husband and dog Bentley. I adore and live for my family, including my boating family.
